content.title: 2026 Kentucky Derby Day Simulcast
content.text: Saturday, May 2, 2026 The greatest two minutes in sports – the Kentucky Derby – takes place on Saturday, May 2 and the Meadowlands Racetrack is the best place to watch and wager. Racetrack doors open at 9 am with first Churchill Downs post at 10:30am. Live harness racing kicks off at 6:20 pm and the Kentucky Derby post time is 6:57pm. Dining Café reservations must be pre-paid $125 per 4-person table Waited service Guarantees track admittance and seating Ticket purchase price is also a food credit that can be used at the Cafe on Derby Simulcast Day towards racetrack staples like chicken wings, french fries, cheesesteaks, burgers, pretzels, popcorn, ice cream and more. The credit is valid on Saturday, May 2, 2026 only. Purchase a table Lounge reservations must be pre-paid $75 Bar Seat $150 2-Person Table $300 4-Person Table $300 3-Person Couch $500 5-Person Couch Waited Service Guarantees track admittance and seating Ticket purchase price is also a beverage and food credit to be used at the Victory Bar & Kitchen on Derby Simulcast Day towards delicious fare including burgers, nachos, salads, sandwiches and more. The credit is valid on Saturday, May 2, 2026only. Purchase a table Derby Day Pink Buffet View Menu Seating opens 4:00 pm Buffet opens 4:30 pm Reservations Promotions $1,000 Derby Hat Contest $1,000 total in cash prizes Register between 2pm – 5pm in the Clubhouse Lobby. Judging will take place in the Winner’s Circle around 5pm Prize breakdown: First Place: $500; 2nd Place: $250; 3rd Place: $100; 4th Place: $50; Fanciest: $100 Win Wager Drawing
